import { Overlay, Button } from "march/ui" // Overlay'in bütün özellikleri bir arada: src (resim / video), type, srcset + sizes, poster, alt, svg, draw + animate, // effect, fit, position, inset, top / right / bottom / left, start / end, opacity, blend, front, layer, interactive, class type Ctx = { fillStyle: unknown; fillRect: (x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number) => void } type Info = { width: number; height: number; time: number; theme: { primary: string; cat: string[] } } // bir kutu ve içinde adı: katmanlar bu kutuya yerleşir const Box = (props: { title: string; children?: unknown }) =>
{props.title} {props.children}
// canvas: tema renkleriyle zamanla kayan şeritler const stripes = (ctx: Ctx, info: Info) => { const w = info.width / 8 for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { ctx.fillStyle = info.theme.cat[i % info.theme.cat.length] ?? info.theme.primary ctx.fillRect(((i * w + info.time / 20) % (info.width + w)) - w, 0, w / 2, info.height) } } export function OverlayLab() { let $front = false return
} type="svg" top={2} right="10%" bottom={2} left="60%" m:color="brand-orange" class="lab-svg" /> İmleci kutunun üstünde gezdirin
}
